Subject: Pricing: need a match + fast onboarding window

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Montgomery is evaluating a move off our incumbent for inference (primarily gpt-like workloads across batches). Procurement asked for a competitive match/escape offer that covers: 1) a one-time onboarding credit to offset migration work, 2) a short-term usage rebate tier for 3 months while we ramp, and 3) firm provisioning timelines (we need GA parity in us-west within 6 weeks).

I attached a short doc summarizing their ask (montgomery_pricing_req.pdf). Can you tell us what you can commit to by EOD Tuesday? If we have a matching econ + a clear onboarding plan, we can present to the CFO next week.

Appreciate it —
Aisha
Head of Platform
Montgomery AI

Aisha / Rachel / Sean — attaching the commercial outline and the DocuSign starter. Key bullets: 

- 3-month ramp rebate: 40% rebate on per-token host charges for first 3 months after go-live, applied as credits (redeemable against invoices).
- Onboarding credit: $75k one-time credit applied to month-1 invoice to offset connector work and model validation.
- Commitment: 12-month commitment at a reduced per-unit list rate tied to usage tiers (details in attached PDF).
- Escape clause: If vendor parity (feature or latency) not achieved within 8 weeks, customer may pause commitment and receive an additional 2% credit for month 4.
- Compliance: SOC2 evidence and private VPC options included in the agreement.

Attachments: onboard_sprint_plan.xlsx (detailed 6-week sprint), montgomery_pricing_req.pdf (you sent), DocuSign link to draft commercial terms.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/MTG-2027-0987-sign

Aisha — this is intentionally conservative on timing (8 weeks escape window) given our provisioning queue. If you need a 6-week hard guarantee, we need an expedited provisioning uplift (ops cost + $15k). Let me know which cadence you prefer and I will update the DocuSign.

Marissa
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proposed match framework + commercial bullets

Thanks — quick technical note to supplement Marissa's sprint (included as a one-page checklist inside onboard_sprint_plan.xlsx):

- Provisioning: us-west dedicated pool normal lead time 6–8 weeks. We can compress to ~4 weeks with an expedited ops uplift and priority on our provisioning queue (requires the $15k uplift Marissa mentioned and an ops approvals ticket).
- Ramp risks: KV-cache priming, tokenizer edge-case differences, and function-calling schema mismatch are the most likely regression vectors. Mitigations: 3 smoke-test days, a staging holdback window (48h), and a rollback snapshot.
- Deliverables week-by-week:
  Week 0: Access + IP allowlist; model variant baseline and test prompts
  Week 1–2: Data connectors + end-to-end kit tests (batch/stream)
  Week 3: Latency tuning, kernel selection tests, quantization checks
  Week 4–6: Full runbook + go/no-go smoke test, pilot at 10% traffic

If Montgomery signs the expedited uplift, we will prioritize your slot and commit to the 4-week target; otherwise plan on 6–8 weeks with the escape window in the commercial terms.

I can join the CFO call if you want to walk through the risk mitigations and what the $75k credit covers.

—Sean
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
